about: The models Nyatch's LLM panel can use, most used first, for each service: what each is for, what it can take, and what it costs. Read from each service's own model list and OpenRouter's catalog. Prices are US dollars per million tokens, in and out. Models change often.

tags.free: Free to use, within the service's limits
tags.balanced: Good answers at a middle price
tags.reasoning: Thinks before answering, for hard questions
tags.long-context: Reads very long documents (a million tokens or more)
tags.web-search: Searches the web for its answers

services.name: Claude
services.note: Every Claude model sees pictures and reads PDFs.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.for: Hard work: long documents, code and careful answers.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.for: Everyday questions and code, at half Opus's price.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.2
models.for: The largest Claude, for the hardest questions.

services.name: ChatGPT
services.note: Every model here sees pictures and reads PDFs.

models.name: GPT-6.2 Astra
models.for: OpenAI's most capable, for hard questions.

models.name: GPT-6.2 Sol
models.for: Everyday questions at a middle price.

models.name: GPT-6.1 Terra
models.for: Good answers at a lower price.

models.name: ChatGPT latest
models.for: The model the ChatGPT app uses now.

services.name: Gemini
services.note: With a free Google AI Studio key, the Flash, Flash-Lite and Gemma models are free within limits; Pro needs billing. Every model here sees pictures and reads PDFs.

models.name: Gemini Flash (latest)
models.for: Always the newest Flash: quick, good answers.

models.name: Gemini Flash-Lite (latest)
models.for: The quickest, with the most free questions a day.

models.name: Gemini Pro (latest)
models.for: Google's most capable, for hard questions.

services.name: Groq
services.note: Every Groq model is free within rate limits, and very fast. Groq's list says which see pictures only by name: Qwen 3.8 does.

models.name: GPT-OSS 120B
models.for: OpenAI's open model: good, fast answers.

models.name: Qwen 3.8 27B
models.for: Fast, and sees pictures and screenshots.

services.name: Mistral
services.note: The free Experiment plan reaches every model, within limits. It is not on by itself: choose it at console.mistral.ai > Billing (it may ask to confirm a phone number), or every model answers 402.

models.name: Magistral Medium
models.for: Thinks step by step, for hard questions.

services.name: Grok
services.note: Names as OpenRouter's catalog lists them. Every model here sees pictures.

models.name: Grok 4.3
models.for: Good answers at a lower price.

services.name: DeepSeek
services.note: DeepSeek's own API has two names, each pointing at its current model. Both read text only.

models.name: DeepSeek Chat
models.for: Everyday questions, at a very low price.

models.name: DeepSeek Reasoner
models.for: Thinks before answering, for hard questions.

services.name: Perplexity
services.note: Every Perplexity model searches the web and gives its sources.

models.name: Sonar Reasoning Pro
models.for: Thinks through a question, with the web.

services.name: OpenRouter
services.note: One key reaches hundreds of models. Free ones end in ":free" and need free models allowed at openrouter.ai > Settings > Privacy.

models.name: Auto
models.for: OpenRouter picks a model for each question.

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
models.for: Free, and sees pictures and screenshots.

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.for: Very cheap, and sees pictures here.
